name: manual_d892d8
claim: Do small, directly-related follow-up tasks in the same session, never defer them as a vague 'follow-up'. Procrastination leads to forgetting and stale/overdue debt.

decisions.notes: User-stated 2026-06-22. Context is freshest the moment the related need surfaces; deferred 'I'll flag it later' items are exactly what gets forgotten.
